decisions.reason: As a portfolio-broadening supplement line close to the firm’s existing offer and kept visible for two years, it likely meets at least modest aspirations and the firm’s expansion slack supports retaining it.

This adjacent consumer-health supplement has only limited evidence of standout success, but its fit with the pharmacy channel and the firm’s available slack make continued retention slightly more likely than withdrawal.
The product moved from a mention to its own page, suggesting performance at or above aspiration, so an expanding large firm would usually keep it rather than reallocate resources.
The firm highlighted this immune supplement as innovative and gave it its own page, which is a relatively positive signal, and its strategic fit with consumer-health expansion favors keeping it.

An early product problem in a quality-sensitive generic medicine likely put results below aspiration, and for a more distant product the firm has good reason to redeploy resources to safer, better-fitting lines.

Despite being more distant from the established offer, it had a dedicated launch presence and fits the stated goal of broadening prescription and consumer-health products, so retention is slightly more likely than exit.
